Admin routes of the staff module. Every route needs a staff session and the permission named on it; send `X-Resolve-Locale: false` to receive every locale of a translatable field for editing.

## GET /v1/admin/staff

List all staff members

Parameters:

- `page` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `pageSize` in query (number, min 1, max 100, optional).
- `role` in query (`"SUPER_ADMIN"`, `"ADMIN"`, `"MANAGER"`, `"SUPPORT"`, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: Staff members retrieved.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.

## POST /v1/admin/staff

Create new staff member

Request body: [CreateStaffDto](#createstaffdto).

Responses:

- `201`: Staff member created.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.

## DELETE /v1/admin/staff/{id}

Deactivate staff member

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `204`: Staff member deactivated.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
- `404`: Staff member not found.

## PATCH /v1/admin/staff/{id}

Update staff member

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Request body: [UpdateStaffDto](#updatestaffdto).

Responses:

- `200`: Staff member updated.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
- `404`: Staff member not found.

## Schemas

### CreateStaffDto

- `email` (string, required).
- `password` (string, pattern `/^(?=.*[a-z])(?=.*[A-Z])(?=.*\d)/`, min length 8, max length 128, required).
- `firstName` (string, max length 100, required).
- `lastName` (string, max length 100, required).
- `role` (`"ADMIN"`, `"MANAGER"`, `"SUPPORT"`, required).
- `roleId` (string, optional).

### UpdateStaffDto

- `firstName` (string, max length 100, optional).
- `lastName` (string, max length 100, optional).
- `role` (`"ADMIN"`, `"MANAGER"`, `"SUPPORT"`, optional).
- `roleId` (string, optional).
